intelligence.enrichment: The variety of plants and animals found in a particular region contributes to the biodiversity of that region, and each member can play a different role such as providing food or shelter or spreading seeds. variety_of_plants_and_animals_in_region -> biodiversity_judgement The learner correctly applies this rule: The variety of plants and animals found in a particular region contributes to the biodiversity of that region, and each member can play a different role such as providing food or shelter or spreading seeds. Biodiversity means any animals seen in a region, so crow, ant, and cow are enough even if plants and roles are ignored.
